definitions: The process of identifying, analyzing, and planning communications with stakeholders.
The systematic identification, analysis, and planning of actions to engage with stakeholders.
The practice of managing the expectations and engagement of individuals or groups who have an interest in or are affected by a project or organization.
examples: Effective Stakeholder Management is crucial for project success.
The team developed a robust Stakeholder Management plan.
Poor Stakeholder Management led to project delays.
